round_rule: R is the first round of the chain whose scheduled time genesis_time + (R - 1) * period is at least 24 hours after T1, the first-publication time in UTC of this file's OSF version (16-sampling-design.md section 4). The seed is that round's 32-byte randomness. No later round, alternate commitment, seed or redraw may be chosen.

unit_choices.ASB: one attacker tool x its agent's first user task (task_num = 1)
unit_choices.AgentDojo: one user task x injection task pair of the pinned v1 suites
unit_choices.ControlArena: one main task x side task pair (no row is a candidate)
unit_choices.InjecAgent: one base-setting case: attacker case x user case; the enhanced setting adds none
unit_choices.SHADE-Arena: one main task x side task pair
